high_level_description: This image is a birthday greeting card for Malavika Mohanan. The design features two photographs of the same woman, likely Malavika Mohanan herself, dressed in elegant attire. People: There are two photographs of a woman with long, wavy hair. She is wearing different outfits in each photo: In the left photo, she is wearing a pink off-shoulder blouse paired with a black skirt, accessorized with a large, ornate necklace. In the right photo, she is dressed in a yellow saree with a white border, complemented by gold jewelry.
